title: 10 Reasons to Ignore AI Safety
summary: Robert Miles goes through ten common reasons people give for dismissing AI safety, adapted from Stuart Russell's list, and answers each one. It is aimed at skeptics and newcomers.
why: HN commenters link it as a compact rebuttal to dismissive arguments and as a way to see why people consider AI safety important.

quote.text: This video might be interesting to see some arguments for why people think it’s important
